papers.title: Germline Genetic Variants and Epilepsy Surgery Response: Individual Participant Pooled Analysis of 272 Patients.
papers.title_zh: 种系遗传变异和癫痫手术反应： 272名患者的个体参与者汇总分析。
authors: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) Surgery Workgroup, and the Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) Genetics Workgroup
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Genetic testing is increasingly used in presurgical evaluation, but the yield of resection and ablation across germline genetic epilepsies remains uncertain.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review of MEDLINE (PubMed) and Scopus and added cases from 3 institutional cohorts and the Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) databases, including individuals with pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline variants besides tuberous sclerosis who underwent resection or laser ablation. Etiologies were grouped into biologically informed categories (GATORopathies, vascular, overgrowth, copy number variants (CNVs), channelopathies, synaptopathies, and other). Primary outcome was seizure freedom (Engel I) at the last follow-up. Group comparisons used Fisher exact and Kruskal-Wallis tests (α = 0.05; Bonferroni when applicable). Prespecified sensitivity analyses stratified by lesional status, excluded GATORopathies, and restricted to literature-only cases.
RESULTS: We included 224 literature cases (65 studies), 36 institutional cases, and 12 PERC cases (n = 272). The median follow-up was 24 months (interquartile range 12-48.0). Seizure freedom was achieved in vascular disorders 14/19 (73.6%), GATORopathies 79/120 (65.8%), CNVs 18/31 (58.0%), overgrowth 9/16 (56.6%), channelopathies 13/43 (30.0%), synaptopathies 4/18 (22.2%), and other 11/25 (44.0%) (overall p < 0.001). Among cases with available imaging results, 208/253 (82.2%) had epileptogenic MRI lesions, including 64% of channelopathies and 80% of the synaptopathies. In univariate contrasts (each category vs all others), odds of seizure freedom were higher for vascular disorders (2.64-fold, 95% CI 0.87-9.65) and GATORopathies (2.41-fold, 95% CI 1.44-4.09), and lower for synaptopathies (∼4.2-fold lower, OR 0.23, 95% CI 0.05-0.77) and channelopathies (∼4.5-fold lower, OR 0.22, 95% CI 0.09-0.48). Direction and magnitude were consistent across prespecified sensitivity analyses (lesional only, literature only, exclusion of GATORopathies).
DISCUSSION: Resective surgeries can be effective in germline genetic epilepsies, but outcomes vary by pathway. Disorders with discrete, lesional substrates (GATORopathies, vascular) show the highest likelihood of seizure freedom, whereas channelopathies and synaptopathies, despite the presence of MRI lesions, have substantially lower yields even in lesional cases. Prospective, genotype-aware surgical registries with standardized reporting (EEG, imaging, and pathology) and time-to-event outcomes are needed to refine the selection of surgical candidates and quantify seizure and non-seizure-related outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景和目标：基因检测越来越多地用于术前评估，但种系遗传性癫痫的切除和消融产量仍不确定。
方法：我们对MEDLINE （ PubMed ）和Scopus进行了系统评价，并添加了来自3个机构队列和儿科癫痫研究联盟（ PERC ）数据库的病例，其中包括具有致病性/可能致病性种系变异的个体，以及
接受切除或激光消融的结节性硬化症。病因被分为生物学上知情的类别（ GATORopathies、血管、过度生长、拷贝数变异（ CNV ）、通道病变、突触病变等）。主要转归为末次随访时的癫痫发作自由度（ Engel I ）。组比较使用Fisher精确检验和Kruskal-Wallis检验（ α = 0.05 ； Bonferroni ，如适用）。预先指定的敏感性分析已分层
病变状态，排除GATORopathies ，仅限于文献病例。
结果：我们纳入了224个文献病例（ 65项研究）、36个机构病例和12个PERC病例（ n = 272 ）。 中位随访时间为24个月（四分位数间距12-48.0 ）。 血管疾病14/19 (73.6%)、GATORopathies 79/120 (65.8%)、CNVS 18/31 (58.0%)、过度生长9/16 (56.6%)、通道病变13/43 (30.0%)、突触病变4/
18 （ 22.2% ） ，以及其他11/25 （ 44.0% ） （总体p < 0.001 ）。在有可用影像学结果的病例中， 208/253 （ 82.2% ）有癫痫性MRI病变，包括64%的通道病变和80%的突触病变。在单变量对比中（每个类别比所有其他类别） ，血管疾病（ 2.64倍， 95 ％ CI 0.87-9.65 ）和GATORopathies （ 2.41倍， 95 ％ CI 1.44-4.09 ）的癫痫发作自由度几率较高，突触病变（约4.2倍低
， OR 0.23 ， 95% CI 0.05-0.77 ）和通道病变（降低约4.5倍， OR 0.22 ， 95% CI 0.09-0.48 ）。 在预先指定的敏感性分析（仅病灶、仅文献、排除GATORopathies ）中，方向和幅度是一致的。
讨论：切除手术在生殖系遗传性癫痫中可能是有效的，但结果因途径而异。 具有离散的病变底物（ GATORopathies ，血管）的疾病显示出
癫痫发作自由，而尽管存在MRI病变，但即使在病变情况下，通道病变和突触病变的产量也要低得多。需要具有标准化报告（脑电图、成像和病理学）和事件发生时间结果的前瞻性基因型感知手术登记，以改进手术候选者的选择并量化癫痫发作和非癫痫发作相关结果。

papers.title: Global Epidemiology of Neonatal and Infantile-Onset Epilepsies and Epilepsy Syndromes (GENIE): A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.title_zh: 新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征（ GENIE ）的全球流行病学：系统评价和荟萃分析。
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Despite the profound impact of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies on neurodevelopmental outcomes and mortality, consolidated global epidemiological evidence remains lacking.
OBJECTIVES: To estimate the global incidence and prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies and epilepsy syndromes and to characterize their associated etiological profiles.
DATA SOURCES: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched from inception through December 18, 2025.
STUDY SELECTION: Population-based observational studies reporting the incidence or prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies or epilepsy syndromes were eligible for inclusion.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Two authors independently and in duplicate performed study selection, data extraction, and quality assessment of included studies using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal checklist for prevalence studies. Generalized linear mixed-model random-effects meta-analysis was used to pool the estimates of incidence, prevalence, and etiology. Subgroup meta-analyses were conducted by country, World Health Organization (WHO) region, World Bank income, and diagnostic criteria. Metaregression was used to investigate the association between study-level covariates and pooled incidence estimates of infantile-onset epilepsy syndromes.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Cumulative incidence and prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies and epilepsy syndromes.
RESULTS: A total of 86 population-based studies from 30 countries across 4 WHO regions were included. The pooled cumulative incidence of infantile-onset epilepsies within the first 2 years of life was 236.0 cases (95% CI, 164.7-338.2; 95% prediction interval [PI], 53.0-1044.3) per 100 000 live births. Among epilepsy syndrome subgroups, developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) had the highest incidence at 67.7 cases (95% CI, 42.1-108.9; 95% PI, 7.1-636.1) per 100 000 live births. Infantile epileptic spasms syndrome (IESS) was the most incident DEE, with 31.6 cases (95% CI, 27.5-36.2; 95% PI, 13.7-72.6) per 100 000 live births. Among self-limited epilepsies, self-limited infantile epilepsy had the highest incidence at 13.0 cases (95% CI, 9.2-18.2; 95% PI, 6.4-26.4) per 100 000 live births. Subgroup analyses revealed limited geographical representativeness, with the majority of studies from high-income countries in the European Region.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The findings underscore a significant global burden of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies, primarily driven by DEEs, specifically IESS. Given substantial between-study heterogeneity, the pooled estimates should be interpreted as broad indicators rather than precise, generalizable rates. Geographic disparities, with a lack of data from the African and Eastern Mediterranean Regions, underscore the need for population-based studies in underrepresented regions and longitudinal research on survival, remission, and functional outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：尽管新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫对神经发育结局和死亡率产生了深远影响，但仍缺乏综合的全球流行病学证据。
目的：估计新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征的全球发病率和患病率，并表征其相关的病因特征。
数据来源：搜索了PubMed、Embase、Web of Science和Scopus
直至2025年12月18日。
研究选择：报告新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫或癫痫综合征的发生率或患病率的基于人群的观察性研究符合纳入标准。
数据提取和合成：两名作者使用Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal （乔安娜·布里格斯研究所批判性评估）检查表独立进行研究选择、数据提取和纳入研究的质量评估，一式两份
用于患病率研究。使用广义线性混合模型随机效应荟萃分析来汇总发病率、患病率和病因学的估计。 按国家、世界卫生组织（ WHO ）地区、世界银行收入和诊断标准进行亚组荟萃分析。 Metaregression用于研究婴儿发病性癫痫综合征的研究水平协变量与汇总发病率估计之间的关联。
主要
结局和措施：新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征的累积发病率和患病率。
结果：共纳入了来自4个世卫组织区域30个国家的86项基于人群的研究。 出生后2年内婴儿发病癫痫的累计发病率为每10万例活产236.0例（ 95% CI ， 164.7-338.2 ； 95%预测间隔[PI] ， 53.0-1044.3 ）。在癫痫综合征中
发育性脑病和癫痫性脑病（ DEEs ）的发生率最高，为每10万例活产67.7例（ 95% CI ， 42.1-108.9 ； 95% PI ， 7.1-636.1 ）。婴儿癫痫痉挛综合征（ IESS ）是发生率最高的DEE ，每10万例活产中有31.6例（ 95% CI ， 27.5-36.2 ； 95% PI ， 13.7-72.6 ）。在自限性癫痫中，自限性婴幼儿癫痫的发病率最高，为13.0例（ 95% CI ， 9.2-18.2 ； 95% PI
， 6.4-26.4 ）每10万例活产。 亚组分析显示地域代表性有限，大多数研究来自欧洲地区的高收入国家。
结论和相关性：研究结果强调了新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫的重大全球负担，主要由DEE驱动，特别是IESS。 鉴于研究之间存在显著的异质性，汇总的估计应解释为
d指标，而不是精确的、可概括的比率。地理差异，缺乏来自非洲和东地中海地区的数据，强调需要在代表性不足的地区进行基于人群的研究，并对生存、缓解和功能结局进行纵向研究。

papers.title: Compensation of hyperexcitability with simulation-based inference.
papers.title_zh: 利用基于模拟的推断研究神经过度兴奋的补偿机制
papers.abstract: The activity of healthy neuronal networks is tightly regulated, and a shift toward hyperexcitability can cause various problems, such as epilepsies, memory deficits, and motor disorders. Numerous cellular, synaptic, and intrinsic mechanisms of hyperexcitability and compensatory mechanisms to restore healthy activity have been proposed. However, quantifying multiple compensatory mechanisms and their dependence on specific pathophysiological mechanisms has proven challenging, even in computational models. We use simulation-based inference to quantify the interactions of putative compensatory mechanisms in a spiking neuronal network model. Various parameters of the model can compensate for the changes in other parameters to maintain baseline activity, and we estimated their compensatory potential. Furthermore, specific causes of hyperexcitability - interneuron loss, excitatory recurrent synapses, and principal cell depolarization - have distinct compensatory mechanisms that can restore normal excitability. Our results show that spiking neuronal network simulators could generate hypotheses about the mechanisms of pathophysiological network mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh:
健康的神经元网络的活动受到严格调节，向过度兴奋的转变可能导致各种问题，如癫痫、记忆缺陷和运动障碍。已经提出了许多细胞、突触和内在的过度兴奋机制和恢复健康活动的补偿机制。然而，量化多种补偿机制及其对特定病理生理机制的依赖
isms已被证明具有挑战性，即使在计算模型中也是如此。我们使用基于模拟的推理来量化峰值神经元网络模型中假定的补偿机制的相互作用。模型的各种参数可以补偿其他参数的变化以维持基线活性，我们估计了它们的补偿潜力。此外，过度兴奋的具体原因-中间神经元丢失，兴奋性复发性SYN
aPES和主细胞去极化-具有独特的补偿机制，可以恢复正常的兴奋性。我们的结果表明，尖峰神经元网络模拟器可以产生关于病理生理网络机制的假设。

papers.title: Amygdala beta bursts modulate hippocampal neuronal dynamics during human emotional processing.
papers.title_zh: 杏仁核β爆发在人类情绪处理过程中调节海马神经元动态。
papers.abstract: The amygdala and hippocampus are key structures in emotional processing, yet the transient neural dynamics coordinating their interaction remain poorly understood. We simultaneously recorded single-neuron activity and local field potentials from these regions in epilepsy patients performing an emotional image-rating task. Neurons in both regions exhibited firing rate changes predictive of subjective emotional valence. While conventional spectral analysis revealed no valence-specific patterns, beta bursts (13-30 Hz)-transient, high-power events-were selectively modified by task features. In both regions, beta bursts were associated with increased gamma amplitude and enhanced phase coherence, with beta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling capturing emotion-related dynamics. Critically, amygdala beta bursts were associated with valence-dependent, bidirectional modulation of hippocampal interneuron firing - decreased during very unpleasant/highest arousal processing and increased during high-arousal very pleasant processing - while putative pyramidal-cell firing did not change significantly. Hippocampal bursts showed no reciprocal influence. These findings suggest that beta bursts may represent a temporally precise neural correlate of emotional appraisal and a potential target for neuromodulation in mood disorders.
papers.abstract_zh:
杏仁核和海马体是情绪处理的关键结构，但协调它们相互作用的短暂神经动力学仍然知之甚少。我们同时记录了执行情绪图像评级任务的癫痫患者这些区域的单个神经元活动和局部场电位。两个区域的神经元都表现出预测主观情绪价的放电速率变化。而传统的光谱
分析显示没有价特异性模式， β突发（ 13-30 Hz ） -瞬态，高功率事件-被任务特征选择性地修改。在这两个区域中， β突发与增加的伽马振幅和增强的相位相干性相关， β-伽马相位振幅耦合捕获情绪相关的动态。关键的是，杏仁核β爆发与海马神经间核的化合价依赖性双向调节有关。
n激发-在非常不愉快/最高唤醒处理期间减少，在高唤醒非常愉快处理期间增加-而假定的锥体细胞激发没有显着变化。海马突发未显示出相互影响。这些发现表明， β突发可能代表情绪评估的时间精确的神经相关性，以及情绪障碍中神经调节的潜在目标。

papers.title: Clock neurons modulate seizure timing through a diurnal switch.
papers.title_zh: 时钟神经元通过昼夜开关调节癫痫发作时间。
papers.abstract: People with epilepsy experience daily oscillations in seizure risk. Using a video-tracking model to automate detection, we explored mechanisms underlying spontaneous seizures in Drosophila and find that flies, like people, exhibit daily oscillations in seizure risk. These rhythms are absent in flies lacking a molecular circadian clock and are independent of sleep. Thermogenetic screening and cell-specific clock perturbations reveal that the ventrolateral neurons, including "morning cells", and dorsolateral neurons, comprising the "evening cells", modulate diurnal oscillations in seizure risk. Pigment-dispersing factor and short neuropeptide F from morning cells increase seizure risk during the day. During this time, morning cell activity increases whole-brain activity. At night, morning cells switch to glycine signaling likely acting on evening cells to decrease seizure risk. Optogenetic inhibition of clock neurons suppresses seizure risk. Our findings reveal an unexpected role for brain clock neurons in modulating daily seizure risk.
papers.abstract_zh:
癫痫患者每天都会经历癫痫发作风险的振荡。使用视频跟踪模型来自动检测，我们探索了果蝇自发性癫痫发作的机制，并发现果蝇与人类一样，在癫痫发作风险方面表现出日常振荡。这些节律在缺乏分子生物钟的苍蝇中不存在，并且与睡眠无关。热生成筛查和细胞特异性时钟扰动表明，
包括“晨细胞”在内的外侧神经元和包括“晚细胞”在内的背外侧神经元调节癫痫发作风险中的昼夜振荡。来自早晨细胞的色素分散因子和短神经肽F会增加白天的癫痫发作风险。在此期间，早晨细胞活动会增加全脑活动。在夜间，早晨细胞切换到甘氨酸信号传导，可能作用于晚间细胞以降低癫痫发作的风险。光遗传学
抑制时钟神经元可抑制癫痫发作的风险。我们的研究结果揭示了大脑时钟神经元在调节每日癫痫发作风险方面的意外作用。

papers.title: Zona incerta somatostatin+ neurons modulate seizure progression through hypothalamic circuits.
papers.title_zh: 生长抑素带+神经元通过下丘脑回路调节癫痫发作进展。
papers.abstract: GABAergic neurons critically regulate epileptic seizures, yet circuit mechanisms mediated by subtype-specific GABAergic neurons in the zona incerta (ZI) remain unclear. Here we reveal the essential role of ZI somatostatin+ GABAergic neurons in seizure modulation in the mouse hippocampal kindling model. In vivo Ca2+ fiber photometry and optogenetics show that ZI GABAergic neurons are gradually activated during seizure progression. Opto-activation inhibits seizure progression, especially the spread of generalized seizures at the later phase, whereas opto-inhibition accelerates it. Although both somatostatin+ and parvalbumin+ neurons are dynamically recruited during seizure progression, only somatostatin+ neurons exert bidirectional seizure modulation. Circuitry mapping and functional modulation demonstrate that ZI somatostatin+ neurons projecting to the ventromedial hypothalamus (VMH) glutamatergic neurons suppress the spread of generalized seizures by inhibiting the excitability of VMH-related downstream seizure-spread regions. These findings uncover a cell-type-specific circuit mechanism for seizure regulation by ZI somatostatin+ neurons, highlighting these neurons as a potential therapeutic target for epilepsy.
papers.abstract_zh:
GABA能神经元严格调节癫痫发作，但由未知带（ ZI ）中亚型特异性GABA能神经元介导的电路机制仍不清楚。在这里，我们揭示了ZI生长抑素+ GABA能神经元在小鼠海马点燃模型中癫痫发作调节中的重要作用。体内Ca2 +纤维光度测定和光遗传学表明， ZI GABA能神经元在癫痫发作过程中逐渐被激活。光激活
抑制癫痫发作进展，特别是后期全身性癫痫发作的蔓延，而光抑制加速癫痫发作。虽然生长抑素+和小白蛋白+神经元在癫痫发作过程中都是动态募集的，但只有生长抑素+神经元发挥双向癫痫发作调节作用。电路定位和功能调节表明， ZI生长抑素+神经元投射到腹内侧下丘脑（ VMH ）
非特异性神经元通过抑制与VMH相关的下游癫痫发作扩散区域的兴奋性来抑制全身性癫痫发作的扩散。这些发现揭示了ZI生长抑素+神经元癫痫发作调节的细胞类型特异性电路机制，突出了这些神经元作为癫痫的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Cenobamate in Focal-Onset Refractory and Super-Refractory Status Epilepticus: A Multicenter Cohort Study With Matched Analysis.
papers.title_zh: Cenobamate治疗局灶性难治性和超难治性癫痫发作：一项多中心队列研究与匹配分析。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Cenobamate (CNB) is an antiseizure medication (ASM) with demonstrated efficacy in drug-resistant focal epilepsy, but its role in status epilepticus (SE) remains unclear. Emerging evidence suggests that it may achieve early clinically meaningful seizure control at relatively low doses, with an acceptable safety profile, supporting its potential utility as an urgent adjunctive therapy in severe refractory epilepsy. We aimed to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of CNB for the treatment of focal-onset refractory SE (RSE) and super-refractory SE (SRSE) in real-world clinical practice.
METHODS: We conducted a multicenter retrospective cohort study using a prospectively maintained registry including adult patients with focal RSE and SRSE treated between January 2022 and October 2025. Clinical, EEG, and treatment data were collected. The primary outcome was sustained SE termination (>24 hours) with electroclinical resolution attributable to CNB. A secondary propensity score-matched analysis (1:2) compared CNB-exposed patients with matched nonexposed controls from the same registry (2011-2025), using target trial emulation principles.
RESULTS: Thirty-one patients received CNB (mean age 61 ± 21 years; 54.8% male); 45.2% met criteria for SRSE. CNB was initiated a median of 4 days (interquartile range [IQR] 2-12) after SE onset after failure of 5 ASMs (IQR 4-5), at a median starting dose of 50 mg/d (IQR 25-50). Sustained SE resolution occurred in 26 patients (83.9%), including all patients with RSE (17/17) and 64.3% with SRSE. Response occurred after a median of 2 days (IQR 1-6). In the matched cohort analysis (28 CNB exposed vs 56 controls), SE resolution was higher in CNB-treated patients (82.1% vs 57.1%; p = 0.02). In multivariable analysis, CNB exposure was independently associated with SE resolution (adjusted odds ratio 5.9, 95% CI 1.2-30, p = 0.03). No serious CNB-related adverse events occurred. Mild adverse events were observed in 51.6%, most commonly somnolence. In-hospital mortality was 22.6% with no deaths attributed to CNB.
DISCUSSION: In this multicenter real-world cohort, CNB was associated with high rates of sustained SE termination in RSE and SRSE and improved outcomes compared with matched controls, without serious safety signals. These findings support CNB as a potential adjunctive therapeutic option in refractory focal SE.
CLASSIFICATION OF EVIDENCE: This study provides Class IV evidence that CNB is effective as an adjunctive therapy for the control of focal-onset RSE and SRSE in adult patients.

papers.title: Glioma regulates GABAergic signaling to drive hyperactivity and tumor progression.
papers.title_zh: 胶质瘤调节GABA能信号传导以驱动多动症和肿瘤进展。
papers.abstract: Recent studies have identified bi-directional communication between neurons and glioma tumors as a key driver of hyperexcitability and malignant progression. Although much of this work has focused on the activity of excitatory neurons, the roles of inhibitory neurons remain poorly defined. Using in vivo screening approaches in autochthonous glioma models, we found that the loss of a γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) transporter (Slc6a1) enhanced glioma progression, promoted network hyperactivity, and influenced tonic GABA release by tumors. Mechanistically, we show that glioma tumors influence the activity of inhibitory neurons and that their subsequent stimulation suppresses tumor growth. Further screening of these phenomena identified diazepam binding inhibitor (DBI), a secreted negative allosteric modulator of GABA-A, as a link between glioma-related hyperexcitability and proliferation that functions through modulating inhibitory neuronal signaling. Collectively, our findings indicate that glioma tumors utilize multiple mechanisms to manipulate the activity of inhibitory neurons as a means to drive network hyperactivity, which ultimately facilitates malignant progression.

papers.title: KCNH1 variants associated with neurodevelopmental disorders exhibit prominent gain of function.
papers.title_zh: 与神经发育障碍相关的KCNH1变异体表现出显著的功能增益。
papers.abstract: Pathogenic variants in KCNH1, encoding the human ether-á-go-go voltage-gated potassium channel (EAG1, KV10.1), are associated with the neurodevelopmental disorders Temple-Baraitser syndrome (TBS), Zimmermann-Laband syndrome (ZLS), epileptic encephalopathy, and other undefined neurodevelopmental disorders. Investigating the functional consequences of KCNH1 variants can provide information about molecular and cellular pathophysiological mechanisms and help guide therapeutic directions. In this study, we determined the functional properties of 26 disease-associated KCNH1 variants including three recurrent and six that were previously unpublished. Findings were compared to the wildtype (WT) channel along with six rare population variants. Our approach used automated patch clamp recording of heterologously expressed KCNH1 variants in both the homozygous state (variant alone) and the clinically-relevant heterozygous state (variant co-expressed with WT channels). We also examined the impact of alternative splice isoforms on functional consequences of specific variants. We demonstrated that the majority of disease-associated KCNH1 variants exhibit features consistent with gain-of-function including hyperpolarized voltage-dependence of activation, accelerated activation kinetics, or both that promote hyperpolarization of the resting membrane potential. By contrast, one unique variant discovered previously in an autism cohort had a depolarized voltage-dependence of activation and was associated with a depolarized resting potential in cells. Pharmacological testing of KCNH1 variants demonstrated differences in potency for channel block by imipramine and an investigational non-selective potassium channel blocker (LY97241) for specific variants. Collectively, our findings support gain-of-function as the most common, albeit not exclusive, molecular mechanism underlying KCNH1-related disorders and suggest opportunities for potential therapeutic drug repurposing strategies for these conditions.

papers.title: Short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk in LGI1-antibody encephalitis.
papers.title_zh: LGI1抗体脑炎的短期结局、长期残疾及复发风险
papers.abstract: Leucine-rich glioma-inactivated-1 antibody encephalitis (LGI1-Ab-E) is a common and immunotherapy-responsive form of encephalitis. However, it is not known which immunotherapy regimens improve short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk. Further, it is not known if the widely-utilised modified Rankin Scale (mRS) accurately captures quality of life (QoL) in LGI1-Ab-E, complicating disability measurements and interpretation of immunotherapy responses. A multicentre, international, real-world comparative analysis of patients with LGI1-Ab-E. Retrospective data from patient records evaluated short-term seizure and cognitive outcomes, 1-6 year disability, and future relapse risk associations, by integrating demographics, clinical features investigations and exposures to immunotherapies and antiseizure medications (ASMs). Patient- and neurologist-rated QoL assessments were used to establish an evidence-based mRS threshold for defining clinically significant disability. Cox proportional hazard models, Anderson-Gill, and generalised linear mixed-effects models were employed. 181 patients were included, with median age at onset 63 years (range 23 - 92); 122/181 (67%) were male. Short-term outcomes, evaluated at both five and ten weeks post-treatment initiation, identified exposure to immunotherapies associated with seizure resolution (OR = 13.97, 95%CI = 6.10-32.01; p < 0.0001 and OR = 8.53, 95%CI = 4.14-17.55; p < 0.0001, respectively), notably with corticosteroids, plasma exchange and rituximab, but not ASMs, intravenous immunoglobulins or steroid sparing agents. Conversely, seizure recurrence was observed after discontinuation of oral prednisolone, but not other immunotherapies or ASMs (OR = 39.53, 95%CI = 12.70-122.20, p < 0.0001). To evaluate longer-term disability, first, mRS scores were calibrated using QoL assessments: this identified a significant increase in patient-rated disability at mRS score of 2. Hence, using mRS 0-1 as a favourable outcome, we identified worse mRS at nadir associated with greater one-year disability (OR = 2.56, 95%CI = 1.56-4.20, p = 0.0003), and each month of delayed immunotherapy associated with a 16% increased risk of disability (HR = 1.16, 95%CI = 1.06-1.35, p = 0.004). Additionally, absence of immunotherapy associated both with greater one-year disability (OR = 5.67; 95% CI 1.19-26.54, p = 0.03) and a relapsing course (OR = 7.64, 95%CI = 2.51-21.77, p = 0.0002). Both a relapsing course, observed in 38% of patients, and the number of relapses associated with step-wise worsening of disability and QoL-outcomes. Rituximab exposure was the only identified clinical factor associated with reduced future relapse risk, by 93% (HR = 0.07, 95%CI = 0.01-0.48, p = 0.002). Persistent serum LGI1-IgMs, but not LGI1-IgGs, at one-year, associated with future relapses (HR = 11.69, 95%CI = 1.58-145.80, p = 0.02). Distinctive clinical factors and select immunotherapies, particularly intravenous methylprednisolone and plasma exchange, but not ASMs, associated with favourable short-term outcomes, patient-centric longer-term disability and relapses in LGI1-Ab-E. Our findings provide evidence-based disability thresholds, highlight novel prognostic biomarkers, and pragmatically guide LGI1-Ab-E care, pending randomized clinical trials.

papers.title: Differences in Epilepsy Etiology, Type, Syndrome, and Severity Between Māori and Non-Māori-Non-Pasifika Children With Epilepsy in New Zealand.
papers.title_zh: 新西兰癫痫儿童中毛利人和非毛利人的癫痫病因、类型、综合征和严重程度的差异。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: The World Health Organization's Intersectoral Global Action Plan on Epilepsy and other Neurologic Disorders 2022-2031 aims to minimize epilepsy burden, with an emphasis on Indigenous peoples. Māori, the Indigenous peoples of New Zealand, have a similar prevalence of treated epilepsy to non-Māori yet suffer an increased epilepsy burden. This study aims to describe epilepsy etiology, syndrome, and severity in Māori children compared with non-Māori-non-Pasifika children.
METHODS: Retrospective population-based study using the New Zealand Pharmaceutical Collection. Medical records were reviewed to compare epilepsy etiology, type, syndrome, and severity between Māori and age-matched and sex-matched non-Māori-non-Pasifika children (younger than 18 years) with treated epilepsy. Period prevalence of etiology was compared: logistic regression (odds ratio, OR) for comparisons of within-cohort proportions and Poisson regression (rate ratio, RR) for comparison of population prevalence.
RESULTS: Cohort of 337 Māori and 421 non-Māori-non-Pasifika children (female: 45.4% Māori and 46.6% non-Māori-non-Pasifika). The median age of first seizure was 3.0 years for Māori (interquartile range [IQR]: 0.9-8.0) and 4.0 years for non-Māori-non-Pasifika (IQR: 1.3-8.0). Māori children were more likely to live in high deprivation areas (quintile 5: 48.4% Māori vs 17.3% non-Māori-non-Pasifika). Māori children were more likely to have a preventable cause of their epilepsy than non-Māori-non-Pasifika children (RR: 2.32; 95% CI 1.41-3.80) and more likely to have a structural (RR: 1.43, 95% CI 1.04-1.97) or infectious (RR: 4.72, 95% CI 1.43-15.8) etiology. After adjustment for socioeconomic status and rurality, there was no longer evidence for a difference by ethnicity. Focal epilepsy was the most common epilepsy type (65.6% Māori and 59.4% non-Māori-non-Pasifika), followed by genetic epilepsies (20.2% Māori and 21.9% non-Māori-non-Pasifika). An epilepsy syndrome was identified in 26% of Māori and 36% of non-Māori-non-Pasifika children. Māori children were less likely to have a self-limited epilepsy syndrome (OR: 0.51, 95% CI 0.30-0.83) or developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (OR: 0.59, 95% CI 0.40-0.88) but more likely to have intellectual disability and epilepsy (OR: 1.65, 95% CI 1.18-2.32).
DISCUSSION: Health inequities exist for Māori children who are twice as likely to have preventable epilepsy than non-Māori-non-Pasifika children. This inequity is largely driven by socioeconomic status and rurality.

papers.title: Internet Intervention for Functional Seizures: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.title_zh: 功能性癫痫发作的互联网干预：一项随机临床试验。
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Functional seizures (FS) are a common and disabling presentation in neurology clinics, but evidence-based treatments are difficult to access in Australia and in many regions globally. A brief, scalable, internet-delivered intervention could narrow this treatment gap.
OBJECTIVE: To compare a self-guided and a therapist-guided internet-based intervention for FS, each delivered alongside standard care, with standard care alone.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This was a 3-arm, parallel, randomized clinical trial conducted between February 2022 and April 2024, with follow-up through to 12 months after randomization. The location was a specialist outpatient clinic in Melbourne, Australia. Included were adults (≥18 years) with a documented diagnosis of FS confirmed by video electroencephalogram monitoring and at least 4 seizures per month, excluding comorbid active epilepsy.
INTERVENTIONS: Participants were randomized 1:1:1 to a self-guided internet-based intervention plus standard care, therapist-guided internet-based intervention plus standard care, or standard care alone. Re-PROGRAM is an internet-based intervention developed for FS, comprising 5 structured sessions integrating lifestyle factors, seizure management techniques, and elements of cognitive behavioral, acceptance and commitment, and dialectical behavior therapy.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was monthly seizure frequency at 6 weeks, 6 months, and 12 months after randomization, recorded by daily prospective seizure diary, with retrospective estimates used for incomplete records. Secondary outcomes included depression, anxiety, quality of life, psychosocial functioning, and somatic symptoms.
RESULTS: Of 220 individuals screened for eligibility, 107 (mean [SD] age 36.0 [12.4] years; 89 female [83%]) were randomized. Of these participants, 96 contributed to the full analysis set (29 self-guided, 34 therapist-guided, 33 standard care). The self-guided arm produced significantly greater overall reductions in monthly seizure frequency than standard care (rate ratio [RR], 0.35; 95% CI, 0.18-0.69; Holm-Bonferroni [HB] method P = .006), with sustained between-group effects at 6 weeks (RR, 0.37; 95% CI, 0.18-0.76; HB P = .02), 6 months (RR, 0.31; 95% CI, 0.12-0.78; HB P = .04), and 12 months (RR, 0.35; 95% CI, 0.16-0.78; HB P = .03). The self-guided arm also showed greater improvements in anxiety than standard care at all 3 time points and in depression and mental quality of life at 1 or more time points. The therapist-guided arm showed greater improvement in anxiety at 6 months, but reductions in seizure frequency did not reach statistical significance. Direct comparison between the 2 active arms showed no significant difference in seizure reduction (RR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.33-1.36). Sensitivity analyses confirmed robustness of the primary findings. No adverse events occurred in any arm.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Results of this randomized clinical trial show that in adults with FS, a self-guided internet-based intervention reduced seizure frequency and improved anxiety relative to standard care, offering a scalable option for patients unable to access specialist psychological care.

papers.title: An amygdala-mediated simulation-to-decision cascade aligns interbrain dynamics to solve social dilemmas.
papers.title_zh: 杏仁核介导的模拟决策级联使大脑间动力学保持一致，以解决社会困境。
papers.abstract: Mutual cooperation (MC) requires independent decision-makers to coordinate under uncertainty about each other's intentions. Using simultaneous intracranial electroencephalography from epilepsy-patient dyads playing a real-time iterated prisoner's dilemma, we identified neurocognitive mechanisms that enable interacting brains to align during mutual cooperation. Amygdala interbrain representational alignment (IBRA), similarity in fine-grained neural spectral patterns across partners, emerged selectively during MC and predicted trial-by-trial outcomes. Early θ-suppression-characterized IBRA reflected rapid, history-sensitive alignment, whereas later IBRA, characterized by low-frequency suppression and γ increases, supported coordinated commitment and action. Furthermore, mutual cooperation relied on an amygdala-mediated, simulation-to-decision cascade, operationalized here as a model-based prospective estimate of partner cooperation that guided self-choice. Amygdala low-frequency suppression tracked this prospective estimate of partner cooperation and θ-γ coupling linked this partner estimate to self-decision processes. Conditional cooperators strategically relied on partner tracking, whereas unconditional cooperators leveraged dispositional tolerance of uncertainty to transition into anticipatory neural alignment. These findings reveal the neural interdependency underpinning MC, redefining cooperation not as isolated decision-making but as a dynamic, interbrain, cognitive alignment.

papers.title: Vascular Risk Factors and Late-Onset Epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: 血管危险因素和晚发性癫痫。
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Late-onset epilepsy (LOE; onset at age ≥65 years) is increasingly recognized in older adults and may be associated with vascular risk.
OBJECTIVE: To identify vascular risk factors (VRFs) associated with incident LOE in older adults.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This study is an individual participant data meta-analysis of 6 US population-based prospective cohort studies (the Epilepsy-Cog Study). In 5 cohorts linked to Medicare for epilepsy case ascertainment, follow-up for LOE began when a participant had accrued 2 years of continuous fee-for-service enrollment and was 65 years of age or older and extended to the end of continuous enrollment. Claims linkage covered 1991-2018 in the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study (ARIC), 1992-2019 in the Cardiovascular Health Study (CHS), 2000-2019 in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA), 2000-2020 in the Reasons for Geographic and Racial Differences in Stroke Study (REGARDS), and 1999-2019 in the Washington Heights/Inwood Columbia Aging Project (WHICAP). In the Northern Manhattan Study (NOMAS), which was not Medicare linked and used cohort-based epilepsy case ascertainment, follow-up for LOE began at cohort entry in 1993-2008 and extended to 2024. Data analysis was completed in January 2026.
EXPOSURES: Sociodemographic characteristics and VRFs assessed by self-report, examinations, laboratory measures, and medication use.
MAIN OUTCOME AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was incident LOE. Associations between risk factors and incident LOE were evaluated using multivariable Cox proportional hazards models to estimate hazard ratios.
RESULTS: From 43 753 participants in Epilepsy-Cog, 551 participants with prevalent epilepsy and 945 with no follow-up after Epilepsy-Cog baseline were excluded. Among 42 257 participants (mean [SD] age, 71.4 [6.9] years; 23 383 [56.0%] female) followed up for a mean (SD) of 9.3 (6.2) years, 1500 participants (3.5%) developed LOE (3.8 per 1000 person-years). In fully adjusted models, LOE risk was higher with current smoking (HR = 1.39; 95% CI, 1.18-1.64), hypertension (HR = 1.17; 95% CI, 1.04-1.31), diabetes (HR = 1.42; 95% CI, 1.25-1.62), chronic kidney disease (HR = 1.29; 95% CI, 1.13-1.48), history of stroke (HR = 1.99; 95% CI, 1.63-2.43), and apolipoprotein E ε4 allele (1 ε4 allele: HR = 1.22; 95% CI, 1.07-1.39; 2 ε4 alleles: HR = 1.84; 95% CI, 1.36-2.50). Associations of VRFs with LOE were similar across age, sex, and race and ethnicity subgroups.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this pooled analysis of 6 US cohorts, multiple VRFs and a history of stroke were associated with incident LOE. These findings suggest that LOE may reflect the underlying burden of brain vascular disease.

papers.title: More Than a Daughter: Margaret A. Lennox-Buchthal (1913-2001), Epileptologist.
papers.title_zh: 不仅仅是一个女儿： Margaret A. Lennox-Buchthal （ 1913-2001 ） ，癫痫学家。
papers.abstract: In a 2010 book chapter on the pioneering encephalographer Mary A.B. Brazier, PhD (1904-1995), a photo of a smiling woman is labeled "Margaret Lennox-Buchthal, wife of Fritz, daughter of William Lennox." Yet, like most women, Margaret Lennox-Buchthal, MD (1913-2001), was more than a wife and a daughter. She was an assistant professor at the Yale School of Medicine and associate professor at the University of Copenhagen Institute of Neurophysiology, and she was editor-in-chief of the journal Epilepsia (1969-1975). Her work had a lasting impact on our current concept of and approach to febrile seizures. She advocated for people with epilepsy and challenged stigmas as an educated divorced woman with a diagnosis of epilepsy. The story of Lennox-Buchthal's life illustrates the unsung roles women played in medicine and research in the mid-1900s, and how their achievements continue to be eclipsed by the men in their lives.

papers.title: Parvalbumin cell state dynamics regulate gamma oscillations and are disrupted in Alzheimer's disease.
papers.title_zh: 小清蛋白细胞状态动态调控伽马振荡，并在阿尔茨海默病中受损
papers.abstract: Gamma oscillations are fundamental for cognitive processing, but the cellular and circuit dynamics that generate them remain poorly defined. Establishing a method for simultaneous calcium imaging and electrocorticography recordings in awake mice, we found that spontaneous gamma oscillations are accompanied by dynamic transitions between parvalbumin (PV) interneuron states. Rather than acting as a uniformly synchronized population, PV interneurons showed sequential recruitment, transient inactivation, and frequent transitions between activity states, indicating the formation of dynamic functional networks. In J20 Alzheimer's disease mice, these state transitions became dysregulated, leading to abnormal PV recruitment, impaired coupling between PV activity and gamma oscillations, and network hyperexcitability. Increasing interneuron excitability through expression of the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.1 restored PV cell dynamics, gamma oscillations, and network stability. These findings reveal dynamic PV cell states as an organizing feature of gamma oscillations and identify their disruption as a circuit mechanism of network dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease.

papers.title: Antibody-mediated encephalitides: distinct diseases with transdisciplinary implications.
papers.title_zh: 抗体介导的脑炎：具有跨学科意义的不同疾病。
papers.abstract: The discovery of antibody-mediated glial and neuronal disorders has transformed the diagnosis and treatment of neurological diseases previously considered idiopathic or not recognised as immune-mediated. Antibody-mediated disorders targeting glial aquaporin-4 and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein are distinct nosological entities, defined by specific targets, mechanisms, syndromes, and therapeutic implications. By contrast, antibody-mediated disorders targeting neuronal antigens (ie, autoimmune encephalitides) are still frequently analysed collectively, with data from different disorders pooled as if they represent a single disease rather than distinct entities. Evidence from anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, anti-LGI1 encephalitis, and anti-IgLON5 disease (used here as exemplars of autoimmune encephalitides) indicates that individual autoimmune encephalitides differ in demographics, triggers, mechanisms, clinical manifestations, post-acute trajectories, and treatment requirements. The broad, heterogeneous presentations of autoimmune encephalitides require coordinated multidisciplinary care within and beyond neurology, involving specialists in paediatrics, infectious diseases, epilepsy, movement disorders, sleep medicine, intensive care, cognitive rehabilitation, and other relevant disciplines. Such interdisciplinary collaboration facilitates the recognition of new diseases and elucidation of the causes of previously unclassified disorders. Improving patient care requires not only aetiological and mechanistic insight to enable development of targeted therapies but also strengthened cross-specialty expertise to optimise diagnosis and management.

papers.title: Reframing traumatic brain injury and spinal cord injury as chronic multisystem disorders: toward integrated, long-term care.
papers.title_zh: 将创伤性脑损伤和脊髓损伤重新定义为慢性多系统疾病：面向综合性长期护理。
authors: Global Coalition for TBI as a Notifiable and Chronic Condition
papers.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) and spinal cord injury (SCI) affect more than 220 million people worldwide and are associated with cardiometabolic, endocrine, neurological, and psychiatric sequelae for years to decades after an acute injury. However, most health systems still treat neurotrauma (TBI and SCI, collectively) as a time-limited event, leaving long-term surveillance of these patients fragmented or absent, which leads to preventable mortality and avoidable readmissions. TBI and SCI in adults should be reclassified as acute-onset multisystem chronic-risk conditions. Existing cardiovascular, endocrine, and psychiatric services do not capture neurotrauma-specific risks, including trauma-induced hypopituitarism, autonomic dysregulation, accelerated ageing, and cognitive-behavioural impairment, so neurotrauma care is best framed as a missing node in chronic neurological care. We propose a risk-stratified pathway of care navigation, multisystem screening, and telehealth; convergence with adjacent stroke, cardiometabolic, memory, psychiatric, pain, and epilepsy services; and the financing, workforce, and registry reforms needed to deliver measurable reductions in 5-year mortality, avoidable rehospitalisation, and long-term disability.

papers.title: Association Between Epilepsy and Young-Onset Dementia: Nationwide Data From France and Sweden.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫和年轻型痴呆之间的关联：来自法国和瑞典的全国数据。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Epilepsy is linked to late-onset dementia, but evidence for young-onset dementia (YOD; <65 years) is limited. We assessed the epilepsy-YOD association in France and Sweden and YOD risk after midlife epilepsy.
METHODS: We conducted 3 nationwide analyses. A French nested case-control analysis included patients with incident YOD aged 40-64 years, diagnosed between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2018. Index date was the first YOD-related health care event; controls were risk-set matched on age, sex, and region. A Swedish nested case-control replication included patients with YOD diagnosed between January 1, 1987, and December 31, 2016, with matched controls. In both studies, epilepsy-related diagnoses and antiseizure medication (ASM) dispensations were assessed up to 10 years before index date. Odds ratios (ORs) were estimated with conditional logistic regression. A French retrospective cohort included adults aged 30-55 years with incident epilepsy in 2008, matched to individuals with prevalent epilepsy before 2008 or no epilepsy. The cohort index was the first ASM reimbursement in the incident epilepsy group or the matched date for comparators. Follow-up ended at YOD, death, or 10 years. We estimated 10-year cumulative incidence and adjusted (comorbidities, deprivation) hazard ratios (HRs), treating death as a competing event. Sensitivity analyses included lagged entry up to 5 years.
RESULTS: Case-control studies included 11,360 cases and 113,600 controls in France and 16,433 cases and 164,330 controls in Sweden. In France, 12.5% of YOD cases vs 1.2% of controls had previous epilepsy-related codes (adjusted OR 3.76, 95% CI 3.42-4.14), and 27.3% vs 10.3% had ASM dispensations (adjusted OR 1.44, 95% CI 1.36-1.52). The French cohort included 12,901 individuals with incident epilepsy, 64,083 with prevalent epilepsy, and 129,010 without epilepsy (mean age 44.0 years; 55.5% female participants). Ten-year cumulative YOD incidence was 2.20% (95% CI 1.94-2.48) with incident epilepsy (adjusted HR compared with individuals without epilepsy 6.02, 95% CI 4.98-7.26), 1.74% (1.64-1.85) with prevalent epilepsy (adjusted HR 5.38, 95% CI 4.64-6.25), and 0.21% (0.19-0.24) without epilepsy. Associations attenuated with longer lags but persisted beyond 5 years.
DISCUSSION: Across 2 countries and complementary designs, epilepsy was strongly associated with YOD. Epilepsy conferred higher YOD risk in midlife, especially with multimorbidity, supporting epilepsy inclusion in YOD risk stratification and prevention.

papers.title: Human-artificial intelligence collaboration for comanaging epilepsy in real time.
papers.title_zh: 实时管理癫痫的人工智能协作。
papers.abstract: One-third of the world's 70 million people with epilepsy have seizures uncontrolled by medication, and implantable devices are a promising treatment. These devices can detect impending seizures, missed medication and impaired cognition, but, like most medical devices, they cannot share this information with patients in real time. This is a missed opportunity for devices to learn from clinical events and teach patients how their behaviors affect their health. Here we present a device platform that converses with patients to help them manage their epilepsy. The inpatient prototype links scalp and intracranial electroencephalography (EEG) to a secure, large language model-based artificial intelligence (AI) that communicates bidirectionally through a smartphone app. The AI processes biomarkers of sleep, medication, cognition and seizure probability, notifies patients of clinical events and trends, records symptoms and responses, and uses their feedback to retrain its seizure detector, reducing false alarms. We validated this platform in 13 patients who are undergoing video-EEG monitoring for epilepsy (scalp, n = 11; intracranial, n = 2). In a pseudoprospective simulation, seizure detectors improved precision from patient feedback alone, without expert intervention. We propose this system as a scalable, safeguarded platform for medical devices that can rapidly adapt to patient and provider needs across epilepsy and other medical conditions.

papers.title: A freestanding submicron electrocorticography electrode array.
papers.title_zh: 一种自支撑的亚微米皮层电图电极阵列
papers.abstract: Electrocorticography electrode arrays (EEAs) are key brain-computer interfaces. To be freestanding, which lays the foundation of fabrication and implantation, EEAs need to maintain sufficient rigidity. However, to form seamless and damage-free contact on the cerebral cortex, EEAs should be super-flexible, raising a seemingly unsolvable dilemma. Here, inspired by dragonfly wings, we present a freestanding submicron EEA (fs-EEA) that combines rigidity and flexibility, which are typically mutually exclusive characteristics. A wing vein-like frame is introduced to enable the freestanding capability, while the wing membrane-like functional region of fs-EEA is reduced to 850-nm-thickness that boosts its softness. This fs-EEA ensures excellent cortical conformality and biocompatibility on male epileptic rat models, improves electrocorticographic amplitude and signal-to-noise ratio. Our vein-membrane hybrid structure strategy thus resolves the inherent contradiction of EEAs, and has the potential to support advances in brain science and related fields.

papers.title: Emergency Department Visits for Falls and First-Time Seizure.
papers.title_zh: 急诊科摔倒和首次癫痫发作就诊。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Unrecognized seizures occur in up to 77% of individuals with epilepsy, leading to delays in diagnosis with significant consequences including injury, mortality, impaired psychosocial functioning, and negative socioeconomic impacts. Falls are a common reason to present to the emergency department (ED) and may be a sentinel sign of an unrecognized seizure. Whether falls represent missed opportunities for earlier seizure recognition remains unknown. We therefore evaluated the temporal association between ED visits for falls and first-time seizure.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective case-crossover study using the State Inpatient Databases and State Emergency Department Databases from 11 states (Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Massachusetts, Maryland, Nebraska, New York, Utah, Vermont, and Wisconsin) between 2016 and 2021. Adults aged 18 years and older with an acute care visit for a first-time seizure were identified using ICD-10 codes. Using patients as their own controls, we applied conditional logistic regression to compare the odds of an ED visit for a fall during prespecified case periods preceding the seizure (1-7, 8-30, 31-90, and 91-180 days prior) vs corresponding control periods 1 year earlier. Prespecified intervals were selected to assess graded temporal proximity.
RESULTS: There were 57,547 patients with a first-time seizure and 7,307 patients (mean age 49.3 years and 55.2% female) with at least one prior ED visit for a fall during the case or control periods. ED visits for a fall were more common in case compared with control periods, with the highest odds in the 7 days immediately before the acute care visit for first-time seizure (OR = 2.6, 95% CI 2.2-3.2). In a week-by-week analysis, the association persisted up to 22 weeks before seizure, demonstrating temporal attenuation as time from the event increased. These findings were consistent across age and sex strata and after excluding those who had traumatic brain injury. In analyses restricted to first-time status epilepticus, the association in the 7 days preceding seizure was most pronounced (OR = 4.5, 95% CI 2.5-9.0).
DISCUSSION: ED visits for falls are more common immediately preceding first-time seizure, potentially representing missed opportunities for earlier diagnosis, evaluation, and intervention. Prospective studies are needed to clarify the underlying mechanisms and clinical implications.

papers.title: Contraceptive and Enzyme-Inducing Antiseizure Medication Coprescription Among US Medicaid Beneficiaries With Epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: 美国医疗补助癫痫受益人的避孕和酶诱导抗癫痫药物处方。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: People with epilepsy of child-bearing potential (PWECP) require access to highly effective contraception, yet many antiseizure medications (ASMs) can reduce the effectiveness of some hormonal methods by inducing hepatic enzymes. In this retrospective cohort study, we aimed to identify the proportion of PWECP prescribed a susceptible hormonal contraceptive method who were concurrently prescribed an interacting ASM and patient characteristics associated with coprescription.
METHODS: We obtained Medicaid claims data from 2016 to 2021 for female beneficiaries and defined a cohort of people with epilepsy on ASMs prescribed at least 1 method of hormonal contraception susceptible to hepatic enzyme induction. Using prescription fill dates and contraceptive procedure dates, we identified periods of inducing ASM and susceptible contraceptive overlap lasting at least 14 days. We used descriptive statistics to calculate the proportion experiencing overlap and median days of overlap. We used logistic regression to identify associated patient characteristics with any 14-day period of overlap and binominal regression to identify characteristics associated with greater proportion of overlap days.
RESULTS: Our cohort included 110,976 PWECP (median age 24 [interquartile range 18-30] years, 54.8% White non-Hispanic). Of those, 21,923 were prescribed a susceptible contraceptive method from 2018 to 2021. In that group, 7,154 (32.6%) had at least a 14-day period of overlap with an enzyme-inducing ASM. The median days of overlap for this group were 218 days (interquartile range 74-511). Patient characteristics associated with both any period of overlap and longer periods of overlap included intellectual disability (any overlap: adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 2.33, 95% CI 2.19-2.48; longer overlap: 2.27, 95% CI 2.05-2.53), drug-resistant epilepsy (any overlap: aOR 1.73, 95% CI 1.62-1.84; longer overlap: 1.27, 95% CI 1.14-1.41), and age older than 35 years compared with 19-34 years (any overlap: 1.45, 95% CI 1.32-1.59; longer overlap: 1.51, 95% CI 1.29-1.75).
DISCUSSION: Drug interactions with ASMs leading to reduced contraceptive effectiveness are common among PWECP prescribed susceptible hormonal contraception. Certain populations, including those with intellectual disability, drug-resistant epilepsy, or age older than 35 years, were more likely to experience these drug interactions. Limitations include that our data set lacks information on adherence, counseling, pregnancy intentions, sexual orientation and activity, and barrier use.
